name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd.
about: Five-Star Business Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers business and other loans to small business owners and self-employed individuals, as well as for other purposes such as business expansion, home renovation/improvement and other mortgage purposes, including marriage, education, emergency. It also provides mortgage loans. Five-Star Business Finance Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~7% a year growth, below the ~23% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 11 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 24), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 11 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 25 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
